name: scrub-settle-timing
description: retro-verifies the settle-spring analytic predictions of two fixes (velocity-floor fix, ~141ms hard flick vs ~86ms unclamped, ~120ms perceptibility floor) and (hard-throw damping fix, hard settles ~0.248s LATER than gentle's ~0.1945s, inverted before the fix) shipped without a captured-frame check - both landed on host-only unit-test physics (SidebarScrubMath.slideSpringDisplacement / firstPerceivedSettleTime), never against actual rendered SwiftUI output. Same fixture, startup space, and 3-gesture dance (out/bridge-back/out) as the merged swipe-scroll-phase.json - reuses its exact gentle (dx=90 phase_ms=900 momentum_ms=0) and hard (dx=-45 phase_ms=120 momentum_ms=300) fixtures verbatim, since those are this harness's own established gentle/hard throw shapes - but raises capture fps/duration_ms to get the finest frame resolution the VM will actually deliver, for a pixcmp-based settle-duration measurement instead of a single before/after check. wip: true (diagnostic/measurement helper, not a regression gate - no fixed-duration assertion would be robust to VM load jitter); run by explicit name, not swept by `all`.

actions.note: let the sidebar render and the startup space's (Elsewhere) tab commit
ssh-launched Atrium is not frontmost on a clean snapshot
GENTLE DRAG (a sibling scenario's own slow-scrub fixture): long phase_ms, no momentum tail. Positive dx commits .next: Elsewhere -> Third. Analytic prediction: settles ~0.1945s after release.
OBJECTIVE PROOF the gentle drag actually committed a workspace change (Third's tab, cold at launch)

BRIDGE HOP (unasserted, uncaptured): negative dx commits .previous, Third -> Elsewhere, to reach the OTHER cold neighbor with a genuine single-commit gesture - same shape swipe-scroll-phase.json uses.
gates on the bridge hop's own completion instead of a fixed sleep - see swipe-scroll-phase.json's identical action for the full rationale.

FAST FLICK (a sibling scenario's own fast-flick fixture): short phase_ms + decaying momentum tail. Negative dx commits .previous: Elsewhere -> Editing. Analytic prediction: settles ~0.248s after release (LATER than the gentle drag - the earlier fix).
OBJECTIVE PROOF the fast flick actually committed a workspace change (Editing's tab, cold at launch)

assertions.label: gentle-drag-committed
assertions.desc: gentle drag drove a real workspace change end to end

assertions.label: fast-flick-committed
assertions.desc: fast flick drove a real workspace change end to end
sanity: one real window throughout every hop
